row:
Surry Animal Rescue is a NC certified non-profit volunteer organization.  We operate solely on donations from adoptions and other resources.  We rescue animals from abandonment, abuse, neglect, and euthanasia by providing medical care and foster home placement until loving, permanent homes can be found.

Our mission is to not only help animals in need, but to educate people on properly taking care of their animals. To ensure that animal welfare is our number one priority. We will do everything possible to make sure animals are put in loving foster homes, get the proper vet care they need, and find forever homes to approved adopters.
